title: Playboys Book of Lingerie September October 1991 Intimate Apparel
conditionDescription: Pre-owned vintage issue, complete. These 1970s issues show noticeable handling: cover rubbing/scuffing, edge and corner wear and creasing consistent with their age. Please review the photos for exact condition. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you.
descriptionText:
Playboy's Book of Lingerie, September/October 1991. Cover price $5.95.
"Falling in Love with Intimate Apparel."

A Playboy special edition / newsstand special, not the monthly magazine.

Condition: pre-owned, complete issue with normal signs of age and storage.
